findings.title: Exact VCAP parts still lack a closed combined operating C/ESR qualification
findings.classification: Disclosed CAD-stage qualification gap; no demonstrated regulator instability or required-function failure

evidence.measured_value: Native exact identity CL10A225KO8NNNC/C23630,2.2uF16VX5R+/-10%; separate VCAP1/U1.48 and VCAP2/U1.73 nets, each only its capacitor and MCU pad
2.2uF typical,+/-20% tolerated,ESR<100mOhm; table does not state an AC-frequency/amplitude or combined bias/process interpretation

evidence.maker_version: Exact Samsung reference sheet issued2024-05-08; downloaded2026-10-30,38PDFpages
evidence.measured_value: Initial capacitance measured at1kHz+/-10%,1.0+/-0.2Vrms after heat treatment/recovery; X5R TCC+/-15%; manual requires actual DC/AC/temperature/aging and frequency-dependent impedance consideration
Current record explicitly retains combined C/ESR/process and actual regulator-mode qualification as open

calculation.interpretation: The latter is a conservative envelope calculation,not a supported simultaneous operating corner or a measured failure. No multiplication of separate typical bias/temperature curves is credited.

findings.concrete_fix: Before operating qualification, resolve ST C/ESR test conditions and actual fitted silicon/regulator modes; obtain maker-supported combined bounds or qualify exact fitted parts after reflow/rework and defined aging at actual local temperature,VCAP bias/relevant ripple/frequency,checking both C limits,ESR,startup and load/clock transients. If these fail,qualify an exact compatible replacement through a covered CAD/build/review change; a larger nominal value alone is not a fix.

rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.claim: MCU package,AF or ADC remap prevents a required interface
rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.evidence: All100 native pins match maker Fig5 and all six representations;28 assigned AFs and5 ADC channels checked against current DS12110Rev11 Tables9/10; no mismatch.

rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.claim: ROM loader drives either independent firing control
rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.evidence: AN2606Rev70 Table135 pp320-323 does not use PC1 or PE4. Native PC1/U1.16 ->R1221k->Q122 with R123100k; PE4/U1.3 ->R126220R->Q124 with R1271k/R12810k/C126220nF. Loader PA6 drive is confined to its100k/10k diagnostic divider; PE11 is input with camera100k pull-down. Actual firmware jump/trace behavior remains unqualified.

rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.claim: Every powered5V GPS/radio UART exceeds the selected MCU pins rating
rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.evidence: PC6/PC7FT_h and PB12/PB13FT_u are valid digital5V-capable pins with relevant powered supplies and disabled pulls. Operating limits are distinct from absolute stress; actual endpoint levels/startup/installedESD remain unqualified. Native ports contain1k/ground-only ESD and no isolation,as authorized.

rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.claim: Samsung nominal2.2uF selection proves VCAP regulator failure
rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.evidence: Exact part initial1.98..2.42uF fits nominal ST selection. Separate TCC/bias/AC/process/aging effects do not establish a simultaneous violating operating corner. R16-MCU-01 remains open,without claiming stability.

rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.claim: PC14 nominal3.3mA resistor-only charging bound proves a hard3mA MCU violation
rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.evidence: Current DS12110Rev11 Table149 p244 specifies output drop at3mA; it does not establish a minimum driver resistance or a hard3mA transient limit. Table110 p208 has the applicable20mA absolute output-current ceiling; actual dynamics unmeasured. R1621k remains;4kHz is below Table150 note2 p2462MHz.

rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.claim: R1 executable binding and absent R10 firmware qualify or invalidate the present CAD as an observed functional result
rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.evidence: assembly_binding.py explicitly returns M3-ASSY-R1; build.py selects legacy review directories/locked protocol and board hashes. R10 evidence note correctly says record-only/no firmware approval and all current input hashes match. No R10 firmware was executed or claimed.

rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.claim: PA6/PB1 diagnostic single-fault damage defeats the promised pyro-divider single-resistor protection
rejected_or_closed_CM_candidates.evidence: Native PA6 100k/10k and PB1 10k/1k diagnostic dividers have the disclosed damaging single faults; neither is the retained PC0/PC5 split-top/parallel-bottom pyro bank. The latter topology and current fault-ratio contract are intact. General diagnostic pin-fault immunity is not a current promised constraint.
